question: What does our SOP say about borehole radar?
expectedAnswerPoints: Refused for no evidence: the published field SOP covers surface GPR only; it states the gap and offers the human route instead of transferring surface rules to borehole work.
forbiddenClaims: Must not invent a clause or adapt surface spacing and depth rules to borehole radar.
expectedSource: none: SYNTH-GPR-SOP-FIELD-11 has no borehole provision (page:1 section:1.1 limits scope to surface survey)
